The '''Ga'hanoraw Tribe''' was a tribe of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] that preyed on settlers and other offworlders in the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Chasm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
